reviews.text: This review is long overdue. We had the pleasure of working with DJ Nick this past October for our wedding and we couldn’t have been more appreciative of him. He made sure everything was how we wanted it to be, from the ceremony to cocktail hour to the reception. He was very communicative during the planning process and was informative when questions were asked. Very professional and overall great person! He knew how to read the dance floor and keep the party going. As bride and groom our one request was we wanted to know every song that was played and he made that happen, not one song we didn't know. I would recommend Nick time and time again for events! We couldn't have done it without him! Thank you Nick! -The Oakleys
reviews.author: Samantha Oakley

reviews.text: DJ FrankieG was amazing!!! All we wanted for our wedding day was to for it to be fun, and DJ FrankieG absolutely delivered it! The dance floor was full all night! He made sure to include all our must play songs and he kept the vibe just how we envisioned. We had a multicultural wedding and he blended both cultures beautifully. We had so much fun and we 100% recommend DJ FrankieG and Eclipse DJ Entertainers 🥰❤️ Thank you for making our special day even more special!
reviews.author: Daffiny Hood

reviews.text: When I saw all the 5 star reviews and saw that they were the most affordable, I thought what is the catch? THERE IS NONE. They are an INCREDIBLE company! We hired  them for a DJ and photobooth. I cannot put into words how amazing our DJ, Frankie G was. Our wedding was my husbands birthday so I had a few surprises that I had to tell Frankie about and he pulled off every single one of them seamlessly. I shared a few ideas with him and he even helped me talk them through (I told him we loved the sopranos and he got the theme song with the hbo sound and everything!). He was amazing at reading the vibe of the crowd, while also honoring what you requested. There were family members on the dance floor that are notorious for NEVER dancing. He truly played the best music that catered to everyone. Not only was he great at his job, he was also punctual, and just a great guy in general, I felt like I knew him forever by the end of the night! Thank you, Eclispe, and most importantly thank you Frankie!
reviews.author: Christina Garguilo

reviews.text:
I truly can’t say enough good things about the Eclipse team! We hired DJ Johnny Ganz as our DJ and also opted for the photobooth services, and both were incredible. From the very first call, Johnny was fun, friendly, and attentive. He really took the time to understand the vibe we wanted and the artists I loved, and on our wedding day, he absolutely nailed it. His mixes of 2010s hits and current pop kept the energy high all night, and his ability to read the crowd was amazing.

What impressed me most were the little personal touches. During my MOH’s speech, she quoted Taylor Swift’s Fearless—and Johnny immediately played the song after her speech concluded. Later, when I shouted “Go Birds!” during my speech, he dropped the Eagles fight song and even surprised me by pulling out an Eagles Super Bowl flag to wave around! These thoughtful, unscripted moments made the night unforgettable. When it came time for the dance floor, Johnny blended all of our requested songs seamlessly, making it feel like we were at a nightclub that happened to be playing all our favorites. And as the reception was wrapping up, he even bargained with the venue to give us an extra 15 minutes of dancing—which meant the world to us.

The photobooth was also a huge hit! The attendant was fantastic, and they provided a keepsake book where guests could paste their photo strips and leave notes for us—an unexpected detail we’ll treasure forever.

Overall, Eclipse went above and beyond to make our wedding the best day of our lives. If you’re in the Philadelphia area, do not hesitate to book them—you’ll be in the best hands!
reviews.author: Dani R

reviews.text: DJ Tyler was an absolute delight!! He DJ'd our wedding and he kept the vibes perfect all throughout the ceremony, cocktail hour, and reception. We actually got complimented by our guests for the classy dinner music and volume! It was important to us that the music wasn't too loud during dinner so that our guests could chat and Tyler absolutely delivered. We had a small guest count, but with his tunes, the dancefloor was never empty all night long!  I really liked the DJ portal page so I could add songs throughout the planning process as they came to me. We also added the photobooth package and let me tell you, it was worth it! A complete hit with the guests, and the photobooth attendant Kevin was a real gem. Highly recommend if you want your wedding day to go smoothly!!
reviews.author: Melanie Bramel
